original_sentence: Cali creates new machines that it road-tests in its Caliburger restaurants across the world, into which Flippy will be deployed this year.
translation: Cali 研发新机器，并在其全球 Caliburger 餐厅进行实地测试；Flippy 今年将被部署到这些餐厅中。
